Paper Identification.Title: Heat transfer performance comparisons of five different rectangular channels with parallel angled ribs
Paper Identification.Authors/Year: J. S. Park, J. C. Han, Y. Huang, S. Ou, and R. J. Boyle / 1992
Paper Identification.Study Objective: To systematically investigate and compare the combined effects of channel aspect ratio, rib angle of attack, and flow Reynolds number on heat transfer and pressure drop in short rectangular channels with two opposite ribbed walls.
